Enabling capture_svg processes inline SVG elements when extract_images is on

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"capture_svg\":true,\"extract_images\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Below SVG:</p><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"10\" height=\"10\"><rect width=\"10\" height=\"10\" fill=\"red\"/></svg>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
